high_level_description: A vintage letterpress label for a jar of wildflower honey, ornate frame, aged paper, two-colour print in black and ochre.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Square label on cream paper with uneven ink coverage and small specks, a thin double-line ornamental border with corner flourishes.

elements.desc: Engraved-style drawing of a honeybee above a cluster of wildflowers in the centre of the label.
Ochre serif title arched across the top of the label, uppercase, bold, upright, medium.
Black italic script line under the drawing, sentence case, regular, italic, small.
Small black serif text in the bottom left corner, mixed case, regular, upright, tiny.
Small black serif text along the bottom edge, mixed case, regular, upright, tiny.
